  2418 | |       function describeNode(node, indent) {

  2519 | |       function describeDiff(rootNode) {

  2526 | |       function describeAncestors(ancestor, child, props) {
  2527 | |         for (var fiber = child, node = null, distanceFromLeaf = 0; fiber; )

  2744 | |       function validateDOMNesting(childTag, ancestorInfo) {

  5405 | |       function pushTreeFork(workInProgress, totalChildren) {
  5406 | |         warnIfNotHydrating();
  5407 | |         forkStack[forkStackIndex++] = treeForkCount;
  5408 | |         forkStack[forkStackIndex++] = treeForkProvider;
  5409 | |         treeForkProvider = workInProgress;
  5410 | |         treeForkCount = totalChildren;
  5411 | |       }
  5412 | |       function pushTreeId(workInProgress, totalChildren, index) {
  5413 | |         warnIfNotHydrating();
  5414 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextId;
  5415 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextOverflow;
  5416 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextProvider;
  5417 | |         treeContextProvider = workInProgress;
  5418 | |         var baseIdWithLeadingBit = treeContextId;
  5419 | |         workInProgress = treeContextOverflow;
  5420 | |         var baseLength = 32 - clz32(baseIdWithLeadingBit) - 1;
  5421 | |         baseIdWithLeadingBit &= ~(1 << baseLength);
  5422 | |         index += 1;
  5423 | |         var length = 32 - clz32(totalChildren) + baseLength;
  5424 | |         if (30 < length) {
  5425 | |           var numberOfOverflowBits = baseLength - (baseLength % 5);
  5426 | |           length = (
  5427 | |             baseIdWithLeadingBit &
  5428 | |             ((1 << numberOfOverflowBits) - 1)
  5429 | |           ).toString(32);
  5430 | |           baseIdWithLeadingBit >>= numberOfOverflowBits;
  5431 | |           baseLength -= numberOfOverflowBits;
  5432 | |           treeContextId =
  5433 | |             (1 << (32 - clz32(totalChildren) + baseLength)) |
  5434 | |             (index << baseLength) |
  5435 | |             baseIdWithLeadingBit;
  5436 | |           treeContextOverflow = length + workInProgress;
  5437 | |         } else
  5438 | |           (treeContextId =
  5439 | |             (1 << length) | (index << baseLength) | baseIdWithLeadingBit),
  5440 | |             (treeContextOverflow = workInProgress);
  5441 | |       }
  5442 | |       function pushMaterializedTreeId(workInProgress) {
  5443 | |         warnIfNotHydrating();

  5445 | |           (pushTreeFork(workInProgress, 1), pushTreeId(workInProgress, 1, 0));
  5446 | |       }

  5482 | |       function buildHydrationDiffNode(fiber, distanceFromLeaf) {
  5483 | |         if (null === fiber.return) {
  5484 | |           if (null === hydrationDiffRootDEV)
  5485 | |             hydrationDiffRootDEV = {
  5486 | |               fiber: fiber,

  5494 | |               throw Error(
  5495 | |                 "Saw multiple hydration diff roots in a pass. This is a bug in React."
  5496 | |               );
  5497 | |             hydrationDiffRootDEV.distanceFromLeaf > distanceFromLeaf &&
  5498 | |               (hydrationDiffRootDEV.distanceFromLeaf = distanceFromLeaf);
  5499 | |           }
  5500 | |           return hydrationDiffRootDEV;
  5501 | |         }
  5502 | |         var siblings = buildHydrationDiffNode(
  5503 | |           fiber.return,

  5505 | |         ).children;

  5507 | |           return (
  5508 | |             (siblings = siblings[siblings.length - 1]),
  5509 | |             siblings.distanceFromLeaf > distanceFromLeaf &&
  5510 | |               (siblings.distanceFromLeaf = distanceFromLeaf),
  5511 | |             siblings
  5512 | |           );

  5518 | |           distanceFromLeaf: distanceFromLeaf
  5519 | |         };

  5521 | |         return distanceFromLeaf;
  5522 | |       }

  5538 | |       function throwOnHydrationMismatch(fiber) {

  5551 | |                 diff

  5558 | |       function prepareToHydrateHostInstance(fiber) {

  6564 | |           newFiber.index = newIndex;
  6565 | |           if (!shouldTrackSideEffects)
  6566 | |             return (newFiber.flags |= 1048576), lastPlacedIndex;
  6567 | |           newIndex = newFiber.alternate;
  6568 | |           if (null !== newIndex)
  6569 | |             return (
  6570 | |               (newIndex = newIndex.index),
  6571 | |               newIndex < lastPlacedIndex
  6572 | |                 ? ((newFiber.flags |= 2), lastPlacedIndex)
  6573 | |                 : newIndex
  6574 | |             );
  6575 | |           newFiber.flags |= 134217730;
  6576 | |           return lastPlacedIndex;
  6577 | |         }
  6578 | |         function placeSingleChild(newFiber) {
  6579 | |           shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  6580 | |             null === newFiber.alternate &&
  6581 | |             (newFiber.flags |= 134217730);
  6582 | |           return newFiber;
  6583 | |         }
  6584 | |         function updateTextNode(returnFiber, current, textContent, lanes) {

  6602 | |         }
  6603 | |         function updateElement(returnFiber, current, element, lanes) {

  6679 | |         function createChild(returnFiber, newChild, lanes) {

  6771 | |         function updateSlot(returnFiber, oldFiber, newChild, lanes) {
  6772 | |           var key = null !== oldFiber ? oldFiber.key : null;

  6804 | |                     returnFiber,
  6805 | |                     oldFiber,
  6806 | |                     newChild,

  6810 | |                   returnFiber
  6811 | |                 );
  6812 | |             }

  6814 | |               if (null !== key) return null;

  6817 | |                 returnFiber,
  6818 | |                 oldFiber,

  6830 | |                   returnFiber,

  6847 | |           "function" === typeof newChild &&
  6848 | |             warnOnFunctionType(returnFiber, newChild);
  6849 | |           "symbol" === typeof newChild && warnOnSymbolType(returnFiber, newChild);
  6850 | |           return null;
  6851 | |         }
  6852 | |         function updateFromMap(

  6949 | |         function warnOnInvalidKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child, knownKeys) {
  6950 | |           if ("object" !== typeof child || null === child) return knownKeys;
  6951 | |           switch (child.$$typeof) {
  6952 | |             case REACT_ELEMENT_TYPE:
  6953 | |             case REACT_PORTAL_TYPE:
  6954 | |               warnForMissingKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child);
  6955 | |               var key = child.key;
  6956 | |               if ("string" !== typeof key) break;
  6957 | |               if (null === knownKeys) {
  6958 | |                 knownKeys = new Set();
  6959 | |                 knownKeys.add(key);
  6960 | |                 break;
  6961 | |               }
  6962 | |               if (!knownKeys.has(key)) {
  6963 | |                 knownKeys.add(key);
  6964 | |                 break;
  6965 | |               }
  6966 | |               runWithFiberInDEV(workInProgress, function () {
  6967 | |                 console.error(
  6968 | |                   "Encountered two children with the same key, `%s`. Keys should be unique so that components maintain their identity across updates. Non-unique keys may cause children to be duplicated and/or omitted \u2014 the behavior is unsupported and could change in a future version.",
  6969 | |                   key
  6970 | |                 );
  6971 | |               });
  6972 | |               break;
  6973 | |             case REACT_LAZY_TYPE:
  6974 | |               (child = resolveLazy(child)),
  6975 | |                 warnOnInvalidKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child, knownKeys);
  6976 | |           }
  6977 | |           return knownKeys;
  6978 | |         }
  6979 | |         function reconcileChildrenArray(
  6980 | |           returnFiber,
  6981 | |           currentFirstChild,
  6982 | |           newChildren,
  6983 | |           lanes
  6984 | |         ) {
  6985 | |           for (
  6986 | |             var knownKeys = null,
  6987 | |               resultingFirstChild = null,
  6988 | |               previousNewFiber = null,
  6989 | |               oldFiber = currentFirstChild,
  6990 | |               newIdx = (currentFirstChild = 0),
  6991 | |               nextOldFiber = null;
  6992 | |             null !== oldFiber && newIdx < newChildren.length;
  6993 | |             newIdx++
  6994 | |           ) {
  6995 | |             oldFiber.index > newIdx
  6996 | |               ? ((nextOldFiber = oldFiber), (oldFiber = null))
  6997 | |               : (nextOldFiber = oldFiber.sibling);
  6998 | |             var newFiber = updateSlot(
  6999 | |               returnFiber,
  7000 | |               oldFiber,
  7001 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7002 | |               lanes
  7003 | |             );
  7004 | |             if (null === newFiber) {
  7005 | |               null === oldFiber && (oldFiber = nextOldFiber);
  7006 | |               break;
  7007 | |             }
  7008 | |             knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7009 | |               returnFiber,
  7010 | |               newFiber,
  7011 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7012 | |               knownKeys
  7013 | |             );
  7014 | |             shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  7015 | |               oldFiber &&
  7016 | |               null === newFiber.alternate &&
  7017 | |               deleteChild(returnFiber, oldFiber);
  7018 | |             currentFirstChild = placeChild(newFiber, currentFirstChild, newIdx);
  7019 | |             null === previousNewFiber
  7020 | |               ? (resultingFirstChild = newFiber)
  7021 | |               : (previousNewFiber.sibling = newFiber);
  7022 | |             previousNewFiber = newFiber;
  7023 | |             oldFiber = nextOldFiber;
  7024 | |           }
  7025 | |           if (newIdx === newChildren.length)
  7026 | |             return (
  7027 | |               deleteRemainingChildren(returnFiber, oldFiber),
  7028 | |               isHydrating && pushTreeFork(returnFiber, newIdx),
  7029 | |               resultingFirstChild
  7030 | |             );
  7031 | |           if (null === oldFiber) {
  7032 | |             for (; newIdx < newChildren.length; newIdx++)
  7033 | |               (oldFiber = createChild(returnFiber, newChildren[newIdx], lanes)),
  7034 | |                 null !== oldFiber &&
  7035 | |                   ((knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7036 | |                     returnFiber,
  7037 | |                     oldFiber,
  7038 | |                     newChildren[newIdx],
  7039 | |                     knownKeys
  7040 | |                   )),
  7041 | |                   (currentFirstChild = placeChild(
  7042 | |                     oldFiber,
  7043 | |                     currentFirstChild,
  7044 | |                     newIdx
  7045 | |                   )),
  7046 | |                   null === previousNewFiber
  7047 | |                     ? (resultingFirstChild = oldFiber)
  7048 | |                     : (previousNewFiber.sibling = oldFiber),
  7049 | |                   (previousNewFiber = oldFiber));
  7050 | |             isHydrating && pushTreeFork(returnFiber, newIdx);
  7051 | |             return resultingFirstChild;
  7052 | |           }
  7053 | |           for (
  7054 | |             oldFiber = mapRemainingChildren(oldFiber);
  7055 | |             newIdx < newChildren.length;
  7056 | |             newIdx++
  7057 | |           )
  7058 | |             (nextOldFiber = updateFromMap(
  7059 | |               oldFiber,
  7060 | |               returnFiber,
  7061 | |               newIdx,
  7062 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7063 | |               lanes
  7064 | |             )),
  7065 | |               null !== nextOldFiber &&
  7066 | |                 ((knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7067 | |                   returnFiber,
  7068 | |                   nextOldFiber,
  7069 | |                   newChildren[newIdx],
  7070 | |                   knownKeys
  7071 | |                 )),
  7072 | |                 shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  7073 | |                   ((newFiber = nextOldFiber.alternate),
  7074 | |                   null !== newFiber &&
  7075 | |                     oldFiber.delete(
  7076 | |                       null === newFiber.key ? newIdx : newFiber.key
  7077 | |                     )),
  7078 | |                 (currentFirstChild = placeChild(
  7079 | |                   nextOldFiber,
  7080 | |                   currentFirstChild,
  7081 | |                   newIdx
  7082 | |                 )),
  7083 | |                 null === previousNewFiber
  7084 | |                   ? (resultingFirstChild = nextOldFiber)
  7085 | |                   : (previousNewFiber.sibling = nextOldFiber),
  7086 | |                 (previousNewFiber = nextOldFiber));
  7087 | |           shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  7088 | |             oldFiber.forEach(function (child) {
  7089 | |               return deleteChild(returnFiber, child);
  7090 | |             });
  7091 | |           isHydrating && pushTreeFork(returnFiber, newIdx);
  7092 | |           return resultingFirstChild;
  7093 | |         }
  7094 | |         function reconcileChildrenIterator(
  7095 | |           returnFiber,
  7096 | |           currentFirstChild,
  7097 | |           newChildren,
  7098 | |           lanes
  7099 | |         ) {
  7100 | |           if (null == newChildren)
  7101 | |             throw Error("An iterable object provided no iterator.");
  7102 | |           for (
  7103 | |             var resultingFirstChild = null,
  7104 | |               previousNewFiber = null,
  7105 | |               oldFiber = currentFirstChild,
  7106 | |               newIdx = (currentFirstChild = 0),
  7107 | |               nextOldFiber = null,
  7108 | |               knownKeys = null,
  7109 | |               step = newChildren.next();
  7110 | |             null !== oldFiber && !step.done;
  7111 | |             newIdx++, step = newChildren.next()
  7112 | |           ) {
  7113 | |             oldFiber.index > newIdx

  8716 | |       function dispatchActionState(
  8717 | |         fiber,
  8718 | |         actionQueue,
  8719 | |         setPendingState,
  8720 | |         setState,
  8721 | |         payload
  8722 | |       ) {
  8723 | |         if (isRenderPhaseUpdate(fiber))
  8724 | |           throw Error("Cannot update action state while rendering.");
  8725 | |         fiber = actionQueue.action;
  8726 | |         if (null !== fiber) {
  8727 | |           var actionNode = {
  8728 | |             payload: payload,
  8729 | |             action: fiber,
  8730 | |             next: null,
  8731 | |             isTransition: !0,
  8732 | |             status: "pending",
  8733 | |             value: null,
  8734 | |             reason: null,
  8735 | |             listeners: [],
  8736 | |             then: function (listener) {
  8737 | |               actionNode.listeners.push(listener);
  8738 | |             }
  8739 | |           };
  8740 | |           null !== ReactSharedInternals.T
  8741 | |             ? setPendingState(!0)
  8742 | |             : (actionNode.isTransition = !1);
  8743 | |           setState(actionNode);
  8744 | |           setPendingState = actionQueue.pending;
  8745 | |           null === setPendingState
  8746 | |             ? ((actionNode.next = actionQueue.pending = actionNode),
  8747 | |               runActionStateAction(actionQueue, actionNode))
  8748 | |             : ((actionNode.next = setPendingState.next),
  8749 | |               (actionQueue.pending = setPendingState.next = actionNode));
  8750 | |         }
  8751 | |       }
  8752 | |       function runActionStateAction(actionQueue, node) {
  8753 | |         var action = node.action,
  8754 | |           payload = node.payload,
  8755 | |           prevState = actionQueue.state;
  8756 | |         if (node.isTransition) {
  8757 | |           var prevTransition = ReactSharedInternals.T,
  8758 | |             currentTransition = {};
  8759 | |           currentTransition.types =
  8760 | |             null !== prevTransition ? prevTransition.types : null;
  8761 | |           currentTransition._updatedFibers = new Set();
  8762 | |           ReactSharedInternals.T = currentTransition;
  8763 | |           try {
  8764 | |             var returnValue = action(prevState, payload),
  8765 | |               onStartTransitionFinish = ReactSharedInternals.S;
  8766 | |             null !== onStartTransitionFinish &&
  8767 | |               onStartTransitionFinish(currentTransition, returnValue);
  8768 | |             handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, returnValue);
  8769 | |           } catch (error) {
  8770 | |             onActionError(actionQueue, node, error);
  8771 | |           } finally {
  8772 | |             null !== prevTransition &&
  8773 | |               null !== currentTransition.types &&
  8774 | |               (null !== prevTransition.types &&
  8775 | |                 prevTransition.types !== currentTransition.types &&
  8776 | |                 console.error(
  8777 | |                   "We expected inner Transitions to have transferred the outer types set and that you cannot add to the outer Transition while inside the inner.This is a bug in React."
  8778 | |                 ),
  8779 | |               (prevTransition.types = currentTransition.types)),
  8780 | |               (ReactSharedInternals.T = prevTransition),
  8781 | |               null === prevTransition &&
  8782 | |                 currentTransition._updatedFibers &&
  8783 | |                 ((actionQueue = currentTransition._updatedFibers.size),
  8784 | |                 currentTransition._updatedFibers.clear(),
  8785 | |                 10 < actionQueue &&
  8786 | |                   console.warn(
  8787 | |                     "Detected a large number of updates inside startTransition. If this is due to a subscription please re-write it to use React provided hooks. Otherwise concurrent mode guarantees are off the table."
  8788 | |                   ));
  8789 | |           }
  8790 | |         } else
  8791 | |           try {
  8792 | |             (currentTransition = action(prevState, payload)),
  8793 | |               handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, currentTransition);
  8794 | |           } catch (error$5) {
  8795 | |             onActionError(actionQueue, node, error$5);
  8796 | |           }
  8797 | |       }
  8798 | |       function handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, returnValue) {
  8799 | |         null !== returnValue &&
  8800 | |         "object" === typeof returnValue &&
  8801 | |         "function" === typeof returnValue.then
  8802 | |           ? (ReactSharedInternals.asyncTransitions++,
  8803 | |             returnValue.then(releaseAsyncTransition, releaseAsyncTransition),
  8804 | |             returnValue.then(
  8805 | |               function (nextState) {
  8806 | |                 onActionSuccess(actionQueue, node, nextState);
  8807 | |               },
  8808 | |               function (error) {
  8809 | |                 return onActionError(actionQueue, node, error);
  8810 | |               }
  8811 | |             ),
  8812 | |             node.isTransition ||
  8813 | |               console.error(
  8814 | |                 "An async function with useActionState was called outside of a transition. This is likely not what you intended (for example, isPending will not update correctly). Either call the returned function inside startTransition, or pass it to an `action` or `formAction` prop."
  8815 | |               ))
  8816 | |           : onActionSuccess(actionQueue, node, returnValue);
  8817 | |       }
  8818 | |       function onActionSuccess(actionQueue, actionNode, nextState) {
  8819 | |         actionNode.status = "fulfilled";
  8820 | |         actionNode.value = nextState;
  8821 | |         notifyActionListeners(actionNode);
  8822 | |         actionQueue.state = nextState;
  8823 | |         actionNode = actionQueue.pending;
  8824 | |         null !== actionNode &&
  8825 | |           ((nextState = actionNode.next),
  8826 | |           nextState === actionNode
  8827 | |             ? (actionQueue.pending = null)
  8828 | |             : ((nextState = nextState.next),
  8829 | |               (actionNode.next = nextState),
  8830 | |               runActionStateAction(actionQueue, nextState)));
  8831 | |       }
  8832 | |       function onActionError(actionQueue, actionNode, error) {
  8833 | |         var last = actionQueue.pending;
  8834 | |         actionQueue.pending = null;
  8835 | |         if (null !== last) {
  8836 | |           last = last.next;
  8837 | |           do
  8838 | |             (actionNode.status = "rejected"),
  8839 | |               (actionNode.reason = error),
  8840 | |               notifyActionListeners(actionNode),
  8841 | |               (actionNode = actionNode.next);
  8842 | |           while (actionNode !== last);
  8843 | |         }
  8844 | |         actionQueue.action = null;
  8845 | |       }

  8849 | |       }

 25883 | |         if (!(resource.state.loading & Inserted)) {
 25884 | |           var precedences = precedencesByRoot.get(root);
 25885 | |           if (precedences) var last = precedences.get(LAST_PRECEDENCE);
 25886 | |           else {

 25895 | |               i++
 25896 | |             ) {

 25899 | |                 "LINK" === node.nodeName ||

 25901 | |               )
 25902 | |                 precedences.set(node.dataset.precedence, node), (last = node);
 25903 | |             }
 25904 | |             last && precedences.set(LAST_PRECEDENCE, last);
 25905 | |           }

 25907 | |           node = nodes.getAttribute("data-precedence");
 25908 | |           i = precedences.get(node) || last;
 25909 | |           i === last && precedences.set(LAST_PRECEDENCE, nodes);
 25910 | |           precedences.set(node, nodes);

 25914 | |           nodes.addEventListener("error", last);

 26133 | |       function dispatchEvent(
 26134 | |         domEventName,
 26135 | |         eventSystemFlags,
 26136 | |         targetContainer,
 26137 | |         nativeEvent
 26138 | |       ) {
 26139 | |         if (_enabled) {
 26140 | |           var blockedOn = findInstanceBlockingEvent(nativeEvent);
 26141 | |           if (null === blockedOn)
 26142 | |             dispatchEventForPluginEventSystem(
 26143 | |               domEventName,
 26144 | |               eventSystemFlags,
 26145 | |               nativeEvent,
 26146 | |               return_targetInst,
 26147 | |               targetContainer

 26150 | |           else if (
 26151 | |             queueIfContinuousEvent(
 26152 | |               blockedOn,
 26153 | |               domEventName,
 26154 | |               eventSystemFlags,
 26155 | |               targetContainer,
 26156 | |               nativeEvent
 26157 | |             )
 26158 | |           )
 26159 | |             nativeEvent.stopPropagation();
 26160 | |           else if (
 26161 | |             (clearIfContinuousEvent(domEventName, nativeEvent),
 26162 | |             eventSystemFlags & 4 &&
 26163 | |               -1 < discreteReplayableEvents.indexOf(domEventName))
 26164 | |           ) {
 26165 | |             for (; null !== blockedOn; ) {
 26166 | |               var fiber = getInstanceFromNode(blockedOn);
 26167 | |               if (null !== fiber)
 26168 | |                 switch (fiber.tag) {
 26169 | |                   case 3:
 26170 | |                     fiber = fiber.stateNode;
 26171 | |                     if (fiber.current.memoizedState.isDehydrated) {
 26172 | |                       var lanes = getHighestPriorityLanes(fiber.pendingLanes);
 26173 | |                       if (0 !== lanes) {
 26174 | |                         var root = fiber;
 26175 | |                         root.pendingLanes |= 2;
 26176 | |                         for (root.entangledLanes |= 2; lanes; ) {
 26177 | |                           var lane = 1 << (31 - clz32(lanes));
 26178 | |                           root.entanglements[1] |= lane;
 26179 | |                           lanes &= ~lane;
 26180 | |                         }
 26181 | |                         ensureRootIsScheduled(fiber);
 26182 | |                         (executionContext & (RenderContext | CommitContext)) ===
 26183 | |                           NoContext &&
 26184 | |                           ((workInProgressRootRenderTargetTime =
 26185 | |                             now$1() + RENDER_TIMEOUT_MS),
 26186 | |                           flushSyncWorkAcrossRoots_impl(0, !1));
 26187 | |                       }
 26188 | |                     }
 26189 | |                     break;
 26190 | |                   case 31:
 26191 | |                   case 13:
 26192 | |                     (root = enqueueConcurrentRenderForLane(fiber, 2)),
 26193 | |                       null !== root && scheduleUpdateOnFiber(root, fiber, 2),
 26194 | |                       flushSyncWork$1(),
 26195 | |                       markRetryLaneIfNotHydrated(fiber, 2);
 26196 | |                 }
 26197 | |               fiber = findInstanceBlockingEvent(nativeEvent);
 26198 | |               null === fiber &&
 26199 | |                 dispatchEventForPluginEventSystem(
 26200 | |                   domEventName,
 26201 | |                   eventSystemFlags,
 26202 | |                   nativeEvent,
 26203 | |                   return_targetInst,
 26204 | |                   targetContainer
 26205 | |                 );
 26206 | |               if (fiber === blockedOn) break;
 26207 | |               blockedOn = fiber;
 26208 | |             }
 26209 | |             null !== blockedOn && nativeEvent.stopPropagation();
 26210 | |           } else
 26211 | |             dispatchEventForPluginEventSystem(
 26212 | |               domEventName,
 26213 | |               eventSystemFlags,
 26214 | |               nativeEvent,
 26215 | |               null,
 26216 | |               targetContainer
 26217 | |             );
 26218 | |         }
 26219 | |       }

  5413 | |       function pushTreeFork(workInProgress, totalChildren) {
  5414 | |         warnIfNotHydrating();
  5415 | |         forkStack[forkStackIndex++] = treeForkCount;
  5416 | |         forkStack[forkStackIndex++] = treeForkProvider;

  5420 | |       function pushTreeId(workInProgress, totalChildren, index) {
  5421 | |         warnIfNotHydrating();
  5422 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextId;
  5423 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextOverflow;
  5424 | |         idStack[idStackIndex++] = treeContextProvider;
  5425 | |         treeContextProvider = workInProgress;
  5426 | |         var baseIdWithLeadingBit = treeContextId;
  5427 | |         workInProgress = treeContextOverflow;
  5428 | |         var baseLength = 32 - clz32(baseIdWithLeadingBit) - 1;
  5429 | |         baseIdWithLeadingBit &= ~(1 << baseLength);
  5430 | |         index += 1;
  5431 | |         var length = 32 - clz32(totalChildren) + baseLength;
  5432 | |         if (30 < length) {
  5433 | |           var numberOfOverflowBits = baseLength - (baseLength % 5);
  5434 | |           length = (
  5435 | |             baseIdWithLeadingBit &
  5436 | |             ((1 << numberOfOverflowBits) - 1)
  5437 | |           ).toString(32);
  5438 | |           baseIdWithLeadingBit >>= numberOfOverflowBits;
  5439 | |           baseLength -= numberOfOverflowBits;
  5440 | |           treeContextId =
  5441 | |             (1 << (32 - clz32(totalChildren) + baseLength)) |
  5442 | |             (index << baseLength) |
  5443 | |             baseIdWithLeadingBit;
  5444 | |           treeContextOverflow = length + workInProgress;
  5445 | |         } else
  5446 | |           (treeContextId =
  5447 | |             (1 << length) | (index << baseLength) | baseIdWithLeadingBit),
  5448 | |             (treeContextOverflow = workInProgress);
  5449 | |       }

  5490 | |       function buildHydrationDiffNode(fiber, distanceFromLeaf) {
  5491 | |         if (null === fiber.return) {
  5492 | |           if (null === hydrationDiffRootDEV)

  5502 | |               throw Error(
  5503 | |                 "Saw multiple hydration diff roots in a pass. This is a bug in React."
  5504 | |               );

  5506 | |               (hydrationDiffRootDEV.distanceFromLeaf = distanceFromLeaf);

  5510 | |         var siblings = buildHydrationDiffNode(

  5526 | |           distanceFromLeaf: distanceFromLeaf
  5527 | |         };

  5530 | |       }

  6545 | |               ? ((returnFiber.deletions = [childToDelete]),
  6546 | |                 (returnFiber.flags |= 16))
  6547 | |               : deletions.push(childToDelete);
  6548 | |           }
  6549 | |         }
  6550 | |         function deleteRemainingChildren(returnFiber, currentFirstChild) {
  6551 | |           if (!shouldTrackSideEffects) return null;
  6552 | |           for (; null !== currentFirstChild; )
  6553 | |             deleteChild(returnFiber, currentFirstChild),
  6554 | |               (currentFirstChild = currentFirstChild.sibling);
  6555 | |           return null;
  6556 | |         }
  6557 | |         function mapRemainingChildren(currentFirstChild) {
  6558 | |           for (var existingChildren = new Map(); null !== currentFirstChild; )
  6559 | |             null === currentFirstChild.key
  6560 | |               ? existingChildren.set(currentFirstChild.index, currentFirstChild)
  6561 | |               : existingChildren.set(currentFirstChild.key, currentFirstChild),
  6562 | |               (currentFirstChild = currentFirstChild.sibling);
  6563 | |           return existingChildren;
  6564 | |         }
  6565 | |         function useFiber(fiber, pendingProps) {
  6566 | |           fiber = createWorkInProgress(fiber, pendingProps);
  6567 | |           fiber.index = 0;
  6568 | |           fiber.sibling = null;
  6569 | |           return fiber;
  6570 | |         }
  6571 | |         function placeChild(newFiber, lastPlacedIndex, newIndex) {
  6572 | |           newFiber.index = newIndex;
  6573 | |           if (!shouldTrackSideEffects)
  6574 | |             return (newFiber.flags |= 1048576), lastPlacedIndex;
  6575 | |           newIndex = newFiber.alternate;
  6576 | |           if (null !== newIndex)
  6577 | |             return (
  6578 | |               (newIndex = newIndex.index),
  6579 | |               newIndex < lastPlacedIndex
  6580 | |                 ? ((newFiber.flags |= 2), lastPlacedIndex)
  6581 | |                 : newIndex
  6582 | |             );
  6583 | |           newFiber.flags |= 134217730;
  6584 | |           return lastPlacedIndex;
  6585 | |         }
  6586 | |         function placeSingleChild(newFiber) {
  6587 | |           shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  6588 | |             null === newFiber.alternate &&
  6589 | |             (newFiber.flags |= 134217730);
  6590 | |           return newFiber;
  6591 | |         }

  6687 | |         function createChild(returnFiber, newChild, lanes) {

  6779 | |         function updateSlot(returnFiber, oldFiber, newChild, lanes) {

  6860 | |         function updateFromMap(

  6957 | |         function warnOnInvalidKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child, knownKeys) {
  6958 | |           if ("object" !== typeof child || null === child) return knownKeys;
  6959 | |           switch (child.$$typeof) {
  6960 | |             case REACT_ELEMENT_TYPE:
  6961 | |             case REACT_PORTAL_TYPE:
  6962 | |               warnForMissingKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child);
  6963 | |               var key = child.key;
  6964 | |               if ("string" !== typeof key) break;
  6965 | |               if (null === knownKeys) {
  6966 | |                 knownKeys = new Set();
  6967 | |                 knownKeys.add(key);
  6968 | |                 break;
  6969 | |               }
  6970 | |               if (!knownKeys.has(key)) {
  6971 | |                 knownKeys.add(key);
  6972 | |                 break;
  6973 | |               }
  6974 | |               runWithFiberInDEV(workInProgress, function () {
  6975 | |                 console.error(
  6976 | |                   "Encountered two children with the same key, `%s`. Keys should be unique so that components maintain their identity across updates. Non-unique keys may cause children to be duplicated and/or omitted \u2014 the behavior is unsupported and could change in a future version.",
  6977 | |                   key
  6978 | |                 );
  6979 | |               });
  6980 | |               break;
  6981 | |             case REACT_LAZY_TYPE:
  6982 | |               (child = resolveLazy(child)),
  6983 | |                 warnOnInvalidKey(returnFiber, workInProgress, child, knownKeys);
  6984 | |           }
  6985 | |           return knownKeys;
  6986 | |         }
  6987 | |         function reconcileChildrenArray(
  6988 | |           returnFiber,
  6989 | |           currentFirstChild,
  6990 | |           newChildren,
  6991 | |           lanes
  6992 | |         ) {
  6993 | |           for (
  6994 | |             var knownKeys = null,
  6995 | |               resultingFirstChild = null,
  6996 | |               previousNewFiber = null,
  6997 | |               oldFiber = currentFirstChild,
  6998 | |               newIdx = (currentFirstChild = 0),
  6999 | |               nextOldFiber = null;
  7000 | |             null !== oldFiber && newIdx < newChildren.length;
  7001 | |             newIdx++
  7002 | |           ) {
  7003 | |             oldFiber.index > newIdx
  7004 | |               ? ((nextOldFiber = oldFiber), (oldFiber = null))
  7005 | |               : (nextOldFiber = oldFiber.sibling);
  7006 | |             var newFiber = updateSlot(
  7007 | |               returnFiber,
  7008 | |               oldFiber,
  7009 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7010 | |               lanes
  7011 | |             );
  7012 | |             if (null === newFiber) {
  7013 | |               null === oldFiber && (oldFiber = nextOldFiber);
  7014 | |               break;
  7015 | |             }
  7016 | |             knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7017 | |               returnFiber,
  7018 | |               newFiber,
  7019 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7020 | |               knownKeys
  7021 | |             );
  7022 | |             shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  7023 | |               oldFiber &&
  7024 | |               null === newFiber.alternate &&
  7025 | |               deleteChild(returnFiber, oldFiber);
  7026 | |             currentFirstChild = placeChild(newFiber, currentFirstChild, newIdx);
  7027 | |             null === previousNewFiber
  7028 | |               ? (resultingFirstChild = newFiber)
  7029 | |               : (previousNewFiber.sibling = newFiber);
  7030 | |             previousNewFiber = newFiber;
  7031 | |             oldFiber = nextOldFiber;
  7032 | |           }
  7033 | |           if (newIdx === newChildren.length)
  7034 | |             return (
  7035 | |               deleteRemainingChildren(returnFiber, oldFiber),
  7036 | |               isHydrating && pushTreeFork(returnFiber, newIdx),
  7037 | |               resultingFirstChild
  7038 | |             );
  7039 | |           if (null === oldFiber) {
  7040 | |             for (; newIdx < newChildren.length; newIdx++)
  7041 | |               (oldFiber = createChild(returnFiber, newChildren[newIdx], lanes)),
  7042 | |                 null !== oldFiber &&
  7043 | |                   ((knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7044 | |                     returnFiber,
  7045 | |                     oldFiber,
  7046 | |                     newChildren[newIdx],
  7047 | |                     knownKeys
  7048 | |                   )),
  7049 | |                   (currentFirstChild = placeChild(
  7050 | |                     oldFiber,
  7051 | |                     currentFirstChild,
  7052 | |                     newIdx
  7053 | |                   )),
  7054 | |                   null === previousNewFiber
  7055 | |                     ? (resultingFirstChild = oldFiber)
  7056 | |                     : (previousNewFiber.sibling = oldFiber),
  7057 | |                   (previousNewFiber = oldFiber));
  7058 | |             isHydrating && pushTreeFork(returnFiber, newIdx);
  7059 | |             return resultingFirstChild;
  7060 | |           }
  7061 | |           for (
  7062 | |             oldFiber = mapRemainingChildren(oldFiber);
  7063 | |             newIdx < newChildren.length;
  7064 | |             newIdx++
  7065 | |           )
  7066 | |             (nextOldFiber = updateFromMap(
  7067 | |               oldFiber,
  7068 | |               returnFiber,
  7069 | |               newIdx,
  7070 | |               newChildren[newIdx],
  7071 | |               lanes
  7072 | |             )),
  7073 | |               null !== nextOldFiber &&
  7074 | |                 ((knownKeys = warnOnInvalidKey(
  7075 | |                   returnFiber,
  7076 | |                   nextOldFiber,
  7077 | |                   newChildren[newIdx],
  7078 | |                   knownKeys
  7079 | |                 )),
  7080 | |                 shouldTrackSideEffects &&
  7081 | |                   ((newFiber = nextOldFiber.alternate),
  7082 | |                   null !== newFiber &&
  7083 | |                     oldFiber.delete(
  7084 | |                       null === newFiber.key ? newIdx : newFiber.key
  7085 | |                     )),
  7086 | |                 (currentFirstChild = placeChild(
  7087 | |                   nextOldFiber,
  7088 | |                   currentFirstChild,
  7089 | |                   newIdx
  7090 | |                 )),
  7091 | |                 null === previousNewFiber
  7092 | |                   ? (resultingFirstChild = nextOldFiber)
  7093 | |                   : (previousNewFiber.sibling = nextOldFiber),

  7102 | |         function reconcileChildrenIterator(

  8724 | |       function dispatchActionState(
  8725 | |         fiber,
  8726 | |         actionQueue,
  8727 | |         setPendingState,
  8728 | |         setState,
  8729 | |         payload
  8730 | |       ) {
  8731 | |         if (isRenderPhaseUpdate(fiber))
  8732 | |           throw Error("Cannot update action state while rendering.");
  8733 | |         fiber = actionQueue.action;
  8734 | |         if (null !== fiber) {
  8735 | |           var actionNode = {
  8736 | |             payload: payload,
  8737 | |             action: fiber,
  8738 | |             next: null,
  8739 | |             isTransition: !0,
  8740 | |             status: "pending",
  8741 | |             value: null,
  8742 | |             reason: null,
  8743 | |             listeners: [],

  8745 | |               actionNode.listeners.push(listener);
  8746 | |             }
  8747 | |           };

  8749 | |             ? setPendingState(!0)

  8751 | |           setState(actionNode);

  8753 | |           null === setPendingState
  8754 | |             ? ((actionNode.next = actionQueue.pending = actionNode),
  8755 | |               runActionStateAction(actionQueue, actionNode))
  8756 | |             : ((actionNode.next = setPendingState.next),
  8757 | |               (actionQueue.pending = setPendingState.next = actionNode));
  8758 | |         }
  8759 | |       }
  8760 | |       function runActionStateAction(actionQueue, node) {
  8761 | |         var action = node.action,
  8762 | |           payload = node.payload,
  8763 | |           prevState = actionQueue.state;
  8764 | |         if (node.isTransition) {
  8765 | |           var prevTransition = ReactSharedInternals.T,
  8766 | |             currentTransition = {};
  8767 | |           currentTransition.types =
  8768 | |             null !== prevTransition ? prevTransition.types : null;
  8769 | |           currentTransition._updatedFibers = new Set();
  8770 | |           ReactSharedInternals.T = currentTransition;
  8771 | |           try {
  8772 | |             var returnValue = action(prevState, payload),
  8773 | |               onStartTransitionFinish = ReactSharedInternals.S;
  8774 | |             null !== onStartTransitionFinish &&
  8775 | |               onStartTransitionFinish(currentTransition, returnValue);
  8776 | |             handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, returnValue);
  8777 | |           } catch (error) {
  8778 | |             onActionError(actionQueue, node, error);
  8779 | |           } finally {
  8780 | |             null !== prevTransition &&
  8781 | |               null !== currentTransition.types &&
  8782 | |               (null !== prevTransition.types &&
  8783 | |                 prevTransition.types !== currentTransition.types &&
  8784 | |                 console.error(
  8785 | |                   "We expected inner Transitions to have transferred the outer types set and that you cannot add to the outer Transition while inside the inner.This is a bug in React."
  8786 | |                 ),
  8787 | |               (prevTransition.types = currentTransition.types)),
  8788 | |               (ReactSharedInternals.T = prevTransition),
  8789 | |               null === prevTransition &&
  8790 | |                 currentTransition._updatedFibers &&
  8791 | |                 ((actionQueue = currentTransition._updatedFibers.size),
  8792 | |                 currentTransition._updatedFibers.clear(),
  8793 | |                 10 < actionQueue &&
  8794 | |                   console.warn(
  8795 | |                     "Detected a large number of updates inside startTransition. If this is due to a subscription please re-write it to use React provided hooks. Otherwise concurrent mode guarantees are off the table."
  8796 | |                   ));
  8797 | |           }
  8798 | |         } else
  8799 | |           try {
  8800 | |             (currentTransition = action(prevState, payload)),
  8801 | |               handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, currentTransition);
  8802 | |           } catch (error$5) {
  8803 | |             onActionError(actionQueue, node, error$5);
  8804 | |           }
  8805 | |       }
  8806 | |       function handleActionReturnValue(actionQueue, node, returnValue) {
  8807 | |         null !== returnValue &&
  8808 | |         "object" === typeof returnValue &&
  8809 | |         "function" === typeof returnValue.then
  8810 | |           ? (ReactSharedInternals.asyncTransitions++,
  8811 | |             returnValue.then(releaseAsyncTransition, releaseAsyncTransition),
  8812 | |             returnValue.then(
  8813 | |               function (nextState) {
  8814 | |                 onActionSuccess(actionQueue, node, nextState);
  8815 | |               },
  8816 | |               function (error) {
  8817 | |                 return onActionError(actionQueue, node, error);
  8818 | |               }
  8819 | |             ),
  8820 | |             node.isTransition ||
  8821 | |               console.error(
  8822 | |                 "An async function with useActionState was called outside of a transition. This is likely not what you intended (for example, isPending will not update correctly). Either call the returned function inside startTransition, or pass it to an `action` or `formAction` prop."
  8823 | |               ))
  8824 | |           : onActionSuccess(actionQueue, node, returnValue);
  8825 | |       }
  8826 | |       function onActionSuccess(actionQueue, actionNode, nextState) {
  8827 | |         actionNode.status = "fulfilled";

  8829 | |         notifyActionListeners(actionNode);

  8833 | |           ((nextState = actionNode.next),
  8834 | |           nextState === actionNode
  8835 | |             ? (actionQueue.pending = null)
  8836 | |             : ((nextState = nextState.next),
  8837 | |               (actionNode.next = nextState),
  8838 | |               runActionStateAction(actionQueue, nextState)));
  8839 | |       }
  8840 | |       function onActionError(actionQueue, actionNode, error) {
  8841 | |         var last = actionQueue.pending;
  8842 | |         actionQueue.pending = null;

  8844 | |           last = last.next;

  8847 | |               (actionNode.reason = error),
  8848 | |               notifyActionListeners(actionNode),
  8849 | |               (actionNode = actionNode.next);

  8851 | |         }

  8853 | |       }

 14302 | |       function commitPlacement(finishedWork) {
 14303 | |         for (

 14305 | |           null !== parentFiber;
 14306 | |   
 14307 | |         ) {

 14311 | |           }

 14313 | |         }

 25891 | |         if (!(resource.state.loading & Inserted)) {
